newsitem.title: UGANDA: Rates decline at Uganda's T-bills auction.
newsitem.headline: Rates decline at Uganda's T-bills auction.

text.p: Interest rates declined at Uganda's treasury bills auction in the month of February, the central Bank of Uganda (BOU) said on Monday.

The market registered gains in the 91-day, 180-day, 273-day and 364-day bill rates. The end-of-the-month profile for these four maturities stood at 10.43 percent, 13.62 percent and 14.13 and 14.13 percent respectively in February compared to 12.81, 14.11, 14.86 and 14.94 percent at the end of January.
The bank gave no indication of the direction the interest rates would take in March.
